scope: Search for independently implemented open-source geometry kernels and reconcile current open-source parser routes against the existing DWG/DXF/ACIS/ACDS evidence ladder; update the plan without adding dependencies, fixtures, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project READMEs, architecture/status documents, release metadata, and published artifact provenance
method.evidenceRule: Project feature tables and README claims establish only declared scope. Parser lineage, kernel lineage, producer provenance, carrier/owner association, native consumer acceptance, and semantic expected values are separate evidence dimensions. Mutable branches are not execution pins.

evidence.topic: IronStream as a non-OCCT kernel candidate
evidence.observed: The repository claims a from-scratch MIT Rust implementation with no shared OCCT code and an OCCT-shaped API. Its architecture calls the current representation a tessellating B-rep using mesh-based BSP booleans; its parity map shows many topology, geometry-intersection, sewing, and I/O routes as partial or unstarted. README describes ported OCCT tests plus narrow closed-form checks. The GitHub releases page reports no releases.
doesNotEstablish: semantic validity of source records decoded by libdxfrw
released artifact maturity or behavior at an immutable source revision
evidence.planUse: Discovery-only independent mesh-kernel candidate. Do not add an adapter or dependency to the implementation path. If used later at a composed checkpoint, limit claims to a pinned mesh projection with independent analytic expectations and explicitly label it TESSELLATED_PROJECTION.

evidence.observed: The repository's broad format ambitions do not change its detailed table, which marks ACIS SAT/SAB unsupported/planned.
doesNotEstablish: a working ACIS parser or kernel route
evidence.planUse: Retain existing candidate stop rule; do not score headline format coverage as an implemented route.

evidence.observed: The current README identifies dwg-rs as a pre-alpha implementation with partial entity decoding and no DXF reader. Its source is separately implemented but based on the same ODA specification authority used by this repository.
doesNotEstablish: DXF read support, a geometry kernel, or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Optional exact-version DWG record/container-boundary differential only, when a concrete local record question warrants it.

evidence.observed: uncad's README describes a read-only common model, with DWG supplied by LibreDWG FFI and ASCII/Binary DXF supplied by undxf; JSON/SVG/PNG are downstream projections.
doesNotEstablish: lossless graph or carrier round-trip from render output
evidence.planUse: Preserve the existing lineage attribution; optionally use a pinned undxf parser route at a composed DXF checkpoint only.

evidence.observed: The README declares a zero-copy typed subset for Binary DXF R13+ with Unknown entities; the repository page shows one commit and no release.
doesNotEstablish: behavior of an exact published artifact
evidence.planUse: Keep discovery-only; pin crate checksum and matching source before any optional read-only comparison.

evidence.topic: cq-acis bounded parser and shared-kernel boundary
evidence.observed: cq-acis provides a distinct SAT/SAB parser and experimental conversion of an explicitly bounded subset through CadQuery/OpenCASCADE. Its docs distinguish parsing from complete shape conversion and document profile and producer limits. It does not parse the outer DWG/DXF container or establish AcDs entity-owner-key-payload association; its OCCT kernel family is shared with FreeCAD.
doesNotEstablish: outer DWG/DXF carrier integrity or owner closure
a second geometry-kernel vote relative to FreeCAD
native FreeCAD acceptance from package publication metadata
evidence.planUse: Keep as an optional, pinned inner-payload parser/shared-OCCT plausibility lane. Verify the selected wheel hash/attestation, exact dependencies, input profile and body/reference completeness if run.
